title: Sparse Cholesky Elimination Tree
summary: This article explains elimination trees, a fundamental data structure used to represent and compute Cholesky factorization of sparse matrices efficiently. It covers how elimination trees capture the dependency patterns in sparse matrix factorization, enabling optimal fill-in minimization and efficient parallel computation.
problem_solved: How to efficiently represent and compute Cholesky factorization of sparse matrices while minimizing fill-in and enabling parallel execution.
why_valuable: Elimination trees are essential for building high-performance sparse matrix solvers used in finite element analysis, circuit simulation, machine learning, and scientific simulations at scale.
